{% extends "layout.html" %}

{% block body %}
    <h1>Register</h1>
    <form action="/register" method="post">
        <input autocomplete="off" autofocus name="name" placeholder="Name" type="text">
        {% for sport in sports %}
            <input name="sport" type="checkbox" value="{{ sport }}"> {{ sport }}
        {% endfor %}
        <button type="submit">Register</button>
    </form>
{% endblock %}
